training.title: Training
briefing: Ten training rings are set up around the island. Fly through the glowing yellow rings in order.
Once you clear them all, two mock enemy fighters will appear above the island.
Shoot both down with your missiles and gun.
Stay inside the combat area (6 km from the island's center).

first-sortie.title: First Sortie
briefing: Unidentified fighters have entered our airspace from the north of the island. This is not a drill.
They will come in one at a time. The first is just probing our defenses. Shoot down all three.
They carry missiles. When the warning sounds, use flares and break hard.

escort.title: Escort
briefing: A transport carrying evacuees will fly from the east coast to the west coast evacuation point.
Four enemy fighters will come after it in two waves.
The transport cannot evade. Drive off the attackers and get it to the west coast.
If the transport is shot down, the mission fails.

strike.title: Strike
briefing: We have located four enemy facilities on the island: a radar, a fuel tank, a hangar and an anti-air gun.
Destroy all of them. The AA gun in the west fires at anything within 2.5 km. When the "AAA" warning appears, turn to break its aim.
The hangar is tough, so use bombs or rockets. The fuel tank explodes; don't pass low right over it.

encounter.title: Encounter
briefing: We have detected two enemy fighters and a huge contact under the sea southeast of the island.
The contact is likely to surface while you are engaging the fighters. Its identity is unknown.
If a giant creature appears, concentrate your fire and drive it back into the sea. Beware of its roar and thrown rocks.
Downing the fighters is optional, but watch your six.

raid.title: Raid: Vorgas
briefing: The giant monster Vorgas is coming ashore from the sea southeast of the island.
Glowing shoulder crystals mean a heat beam; a raised tail means a sweep. Read the tells and dodge.
Break a leg to knock it down and double all damage.
Below 40% health it enters the final phase. Defeat it within 3 minutes or it reaches the city.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.promptBody: Practice flying and shooting in 5 short steps (3–4 minutes). You can also start it later from "Tutorial" in the mode select.

rings.touch: Tilt with the stick (bottom left) and pull to turn. Fly through the 3 yellow rings
rings.keys: Bank with {rollLeft}/{rollRight} and pull with {pitchUp} to turn ({pitchDown} pitches down). Fly through the 3 yellow rings
rings.pad: Bank with the left stick and pull it back to turn. Fly through the 3 yellow rings

speed.touch: Push the throttle (right edge) all the way up and hold AB to reach 360 m/s
speed.keys: Raise the throttle with {throttleUp} and hold {afterburner} (afterburner) to reach 360 m/s
speed.pad: Push the right stick up for throttle and hold LB to reach 360 m/s

targets.touch: Two red balloon targets. Point your nose at them and shoot them down with GUN (◇ marks a target)
targets.keys: Two red balloon targets. Point your nose at them and shoot with {fire} (◇ marks a target)
targets.pad: Two red balloon targets. Point your nose at them and shoot with RB (◇ marks a target)

drone.touch: Keep the drone near the center of the screen to LOCK, then fire a missile with MSL
drone.keys: Keep the drone near the center of the screen to LOCK, then fire a missile with {missile} (Tab switches target)
drone.pad: Keep the drone near the center of the screen to LOCK, then fire a missile with A (Y switches target)

bandit.touch: Last, one enemy fighter. Shoot it down with guns and missiles. Use FLR when a missile is incoming
bandit.keys: Last, one enemy fighter. Shoot it down with guns and missiles. Press {flare} (flare) when a missile is incoming
bandit.pad: Last, one enemy fighter. Shoot it down with guns and missiles. Press B (flare) when a missile is incoming

tutorial.safety: This is practice: you cannot be shot down, and hitting the ground puts you back in the air

hints.speed: Speed (m/s). Too slow and you stall
hints.altitude: Altitude (m). PULL UP when the ground is close
hints.radar: Radar. Up is where your nose points; red dots are enemies
